Agent SDKs & harnesses (four independent sources converge on the same claim in one day - OneDayAgent targets a full day of autonomous operation rather than a task episode, Muse Code ships persistent async background agents, and an HN front-page post and a Medium essay both name the harness (scheduling, context assembly, tool mediation, policy enforcement) as the engineering discipline with the model as the swappable part; loopx enters as a 'loop engineering state kernel' at +847 from a 3,062 base)

Tool-use & interop standards (A2A passes 150 organisations with v1.0 stable and native integration across Google, Microsoft and AWS, while the decision framework doing the rounds names the actual trade - plain APIs when the caller knows what it wants, MCP when the model must discover capability at runtime, A2A when the counterparty is itself non-deterministic, and MCP buys discovery at the price of a much larger, less predictable trust surface)

AI platform distribution (a hyperscaler claiming the agent-runtime layer is the structurally significant item of the day - cloudflare/computer is the #1 daily star gainer on all of GitHub at +2,802 from a 5,010 base; underneath it the quiet compounder is routing and reach, OmniRoute +2,314 fronting 290+ providers and a Show HN SDK for putting any agent into Slack and Teams, while IBM pilots an eCommerce surface for buying partner-built agents)

AI coding agents (Meta Superintelligence Labs ships Muse Code, a terminal coding agent on Muse Spark 1.2 — a fourth serious player against Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI; PrimeIntellect's prime-agent is the #1 daily gainer at +2,293 on a 7,056 base; Oracle bars AI-generated code from OpenJDK; Databricks publishes on controlling AI-coding spend at scale)

Enterprise agent platforms (US Army Human Resources Command deploys Agentforce for 9.2 million soldiers, veterans and families — one of the largest named agentic deployments by user population — with Salesforce separately clearing DoD Impact Level 5; ServiceNow's AI Control Tower reaches GA with 30 new AWS/Google Cloud/Azure/SAP/Oracle/Workday integrations; A2A argued as the cross-functional layer over siloed per-function SAP assistants)

Agent SDKs, runtimes & harnesses (LangChain names the runtime/framework/harness split precisely — LangGraph the runtime, LangChain the framework, Deep Agents the harness — with real numbers on their own GTM agent at ~10k requests/week and 74% ambient traffic; cloudflare/computer follows through at +872 on day two and denoland/celld ships self-hosted distributed Durable Objects the same day, so the agent-runtime substrate is now contested)

Tool-use & discovery standards (The Bitter Lesson of Tool Calling applies a Sutton-style argument to tool use — hand-engineered tool schemas, routers and selection heuristics lose to scale and general learning, cutting directly against the tool-registry and description-engineering layers most MCP-era agent stacks are building; two practitioner pieces settle MCP-vs-A2A as division of labour, A2A for delegation and MCP for tools and data)

AI platform distribution (Alphabet resets its AI leadership — Hassabis to Alphabet Chief Scientist and Chair of Google DeepMind, Kavukcuoglu taking the operating role reporting to Pichai and owning Gemini model development, the Gemini app and the AI developer platforms, with Jeff Dean also stepping down as chief scientist; on the other side GPT-5.6 Luna reaches free users while Codex sheds 5.4 and Atlas is switched off on 9 August)
